Yes, that's the behavior I wanted. When I pressed Save again with the same address, it told me "You already saved this link. Here it is," kept just the one copy — the count stayed at one — and gave the existing card a little highlight so my eye went right to it. No duplicate cluttering things up. That's exactly the outcome I was hoping for.

Treating two identical addresses as the same link is a sensible starting point, so that works for me.

The only thing I'll flag for later — not now — is that once it points me at the existing card, I'll want to be able to actually open it up and change things on it, like fixing the title or adding my labels. But that's a separate flow. For what you're asking about here, the duplicate handling is right.
